systemFiles.title: System Files
systemFiles.preamble:
Azahar needs console unique data and firmware files from a real console to be able to use some of its features. Such files and data can be set up with the Azahar Artic Setup Tool.

Notes:
• This operation will install console unique data to Azahar, do not share your user or nand folders after performing the setup process!
• While doing the setup process, Azahar will link to the console running the setup tool. You can unlink the console later from the System Files tab in the emulator options menu.
• Do not go online with both Azahar and your 3DS console at the same time after setting up system files, as this could cause issues.
• Old 3DS setup is needed for the New 3DS setup to work (setting up both is recommended).
• Both setup modes will work regardless of the model of the console running the setup tool.
systemFiles.deleteSystemFilesDescription:
This action will unlink your real console from Azahar, with the following consequences:
• Your OTP, SecureInfo and LocalFriendCodeSeed will be removed from Azahar.
• Your friend list will reset and you will be logged out of your NNID/PNID account.
• System files and eshop titles obtained through Azahar will become inaccessible until the same console is linked again using the setup tool (save data will not be lost).

Continue?

general.title: Profile
general.frameLimitEnableDescription: When enabled, emulation speed will be limited to a specified percentage of normal speed.
general.frameLimitSliderDescription: Specifies the percentage to limit emulation speed. With the default of 100% emulation will be limited to normal speed. Values higher or lower will increase or decrease the speed limit.

emulation.title: Emulation
emulation.useHighLevelEmulationDescription: Uses a reimplementation of the system applets instead of low level emulation. Turning this off may be required for some online features to work.

networking.title: Networking
networking.accessNetworkDescription: Allows the emulated console to access online features by using low level emulation for the system applets and the modules required for them.
networking.useWirelessDescription: Reports real nearby Wi-Fi networks as 3DS StreetPass/SpotPass-compatible networks, instead of fake ones.
networking.emulatedNetworkDescription: Inspect the Wi-Fi access points the emulated console can see, and optionally replace them with virtual ones.
networking.useVirtualNetworkDescription: Reports the access points below to the emulated console instead of the real ones.
networking.ssidHint: Leave blank for a hidden network

media.title: Media
media.masterVolumeDescription: Controls the app's overall output volume independently of the emulated game's own volume setting. Hardware volume buttons adjust this value.
media.treatAudioAsMediaSessionDescription: Shows playback controls on the lock screen and notification like a music app, and keeps audio playing when the app is in the background instead of pausing automatically.

graphics.title: Graphics
graphics.spirvShaderGenDescription: Emits the fragment shader used to emulate PICA using SPIR-V instead of GLSL
graphics.asyncShadersDescription: Compiles shaders in the background to reduce stuttering during gameplay. When enabled expect temporary graphical glitches
graphics.internalResolutionDescription: Specifies the resolution used to render at. A high resolution will improve visual quality a lot but is also quite heavy on performance and might cause glitches in certain applications.
graphics.linearFilteringDescription: Enables linear filtering, which causes game visuals to appear smoother.
graphics.shadersAccurateMulDescription: Uses more accurate multiplication in hardware shaders, which may fix some graphical bugs. When enabled, performance will be reduced.
graphics.useDiskShaderCacheDescription: Reduce stuttering by storing and loading generated shaders to disk. It cannot be used without Enabling Hardware Shader.
graphics.textureFilterDescription: Enhances the visuals of applications by applying a filter to textures. The supported filters are Anime4K Ultrafast, Bicubic, ScaleForce, xBRZ freescale, and MMPX.
graphics.delayRenderThreadDescription: Delay the game render thread when it submits data to the GPU. Helps with performance issues in the (very few) applications with dynamic framerates.
graphics.factor3dDescription: Specifies the value of the 3D slider. This should be set to higher than 0% when Stereoscopic 3D is enabled.
graphics.disableRightEyeRenderDescription: Greatly improves performance in some applications, but can cause flickering in others.
graphics.cardboardScreenSizeDescription: Scales the screen to a percentage of its original size.
graphics.cardboardXShiftDescription: Specifies the percentage of empty space to shift the screens horizontally. Positive values move the two eyes closer to the middle, while negative values move them away.
graphics.cardboardYShiftDescription: Specifies the percentage of empty space to shift the screens vertically. Positive values move the two eyes towards the bottom, while negative values move them towards the top.
graphics.dumpTexturesDescription: Textures are dumped to dump/textures/[Title ID]/.
graphics.customTexturesDescription: Textures are loaded from load/textures/[Title ID]/.
graphics.asyncCustomLoadingDescription: Load custom textures asynchronously with background threads to reduce loading stutter.
graphics.textureSamplingDescription: Overrides the sampling filter used by games. This can be useful in certain cases with poorly behaved games when upscaling. If unsure, set this to Game Controlled.

system.title: System
system.new3dsDescription: Enables New 3DS exclusive features that are not present on the Old 3DS.
system.lleAppletsDescription: Uses low level emulation of the system applets when available, instead of high level emulation.
system.requiredOnlineLleModulesDescription: Uses low level emulation for modules required for online features, even if LLE Applets is disabled.
system.stepsPerHourDescription: The average number of steps to be generated per hour, for pedometer-based features.
system.scanRealWifiNetworksDescription: Reports real nearby Wi-Fi networks as 3DS StreetPass/SpotPass-compatible networks, instead of fake ones.
system.consoleIdDescription: Tap to regenerate the console ID. Some applications may use this as a form of parental lock.
system.macAddressDescription: Tap to regenerate the network MAC address.
system.pluginLoaderEnableDescription: Allows arbitrary plugins to be loaded into the emulated game.
system.allowPluginLoaderDescription: Allows the game itself to request plugins to be loaded.

camera.title: Camera
camera.imageSourceDescription: Sets the image source of the virtual camera. You can use an image file, or a device camera when supported.
camera.cameraDeviceDescription: If the "Image Source" setting is set to "Device Camera", this sets the physical camera to use.

gamepad.title: Gamepad
gamepad.controllerInputModeDescription: Choose how physical game controllers are mapped to 3DS input.
gamepad.invertLeftStickYAxisDescription: Invert the left stick's vertical axis when using auto-detected controllers.
gamepad.gyroInputSourceDescription: Choose whether motion (gyro) controls come from this device or a connected controller's gyroscope. Falls back to this device if the controller has no gyroscope.
gamepad.dpadAxisDescription: Some controllers may not be able to map their D-pad as an axis. If that's the case, use the D-Pad (buttons) section.
gamepad.dpadButtonsDescription: Only map the D-pad to these if you're facing issues with the D-Pad (Axis) button mappings.
gamepad.useArticBaseController: Use Artic Controller when connected to Artic Base Server
gamepad.useArticBaseControllerDescription: Use the controls provided by Artic Base Server when connected to it instead of the configured input device.

audio.title: Audio
audio.volumeDescription: The emulated 3DS console's own internal volume level, separate from the app's Master Volume.
audio.audioStretchingDescription: Stretches audio to reduce stuttering. Increases audio latency and slightly reduces performance.
audio.realtimeAudioDescription: Reduces audio latency, but may cause instability in some applications. Only takes effect when Audio Stretching is disabled.

debug.title: Debug
debug.warning: These settings are for debugging purposes only. Changing them may cause instability.
debug.logToConsoleDescription: Also prints the native log to the standard output of Flutter.
debug.cpuClockSpeedDescription: Over/Underclocks the emulated CPU. Not recommended.
debug.cpuJitDescription: Uses the Just-In-Time (JIT) compiler for CPU emulation. When disabled, a much slower interpreter is used instead.
debug.hwShadersDescription: Uses hardware shaders to emulate 3DS shaders, instead of the software renderer. Disabling this greatly reduces performance.
debug.vsyncDescription: Synchronizes rendering with the host device's display refresh rate.
debug.rendererDebugDescription: Enables additional renderer debugging features. Reduces performance.
debug.instantDebugLogDescription: Writes to the debug log immediately instead of buffering. Reduces performance.
debug.delayStartLleModulesDescription: Delays the start of LLE modules to work around race conditions.
debug.deterministicAsyncOperationsDescription: Forces asynchronous operations to run in a deterministic order. Reduces performance.

theme.title: Theme and Color
theme.materialYouDescription: Uses colors extracted from your device's wallpaper.
theme.useBlackBackgroundsDescription: Uses black backgrounds when dark mode is enabled, instead of dark gray.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.reduceMotionDescription: Reduces animations and motion effects throughout the app.
accessibility.pageTransitionDescription: How pages animate when they open and close.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.animationSpeedDescription: Controls how fast UI transitions play.

featureFlags.title: Feature Flags
featureFlags.performanceImprovementsDescription: Reduces rendering and processing load. Some visuals are simplified.
